node.title: Universal nondeep tangent support-wise payment
node.statement: REFUTED: outside 3(n-A)<=n-K, a received pair jointly explained on at least A coordinates need not have at most n-A+1 support-wise MCA-bad slopes. In RS[F_17,mu_8,2] at A=3, the pair u=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1), v=(0,0,0,0,0,0,1,2) is jointly zero on six coordinates but has eight exact-A bad slopes, exceeding 6. The witness supports are distinct, low-core, aperiodic, and not an x->x^2 pullback. This is not an official-row refutation.
